notes.title: BEASTWATCH: Meat & Mayhem | Update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h3]The following bugs have been fixed:[/h3]

- The game score had minor issues with tracking game time.
- Some game settings didn't save correctly between game sessions.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the player to unpause the game in Mayhem mode when using a gamepad.

notes.title: BEASTWATCH: Meat & Mayhem IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
The wait is over, go play Beastwatch!

If you find any bug don't hesitate to report it in the discussion section of the game and we will fix it asap.

We hope you enjoy the game, now go kill some piggies and fry some bacon!
